title: One-step rational scalar unit and tower laws
statement: Fix l, finite coefficient fields E,M,L with algebra maps E→M→L, a comparison system C satisfying realization coherence, a scheme Y on which l is invertible and an endomorphism g. The actual rational pullback scalar family satisfies RationalPowerNormalization at iteration length one as defined by [def-trf-iterated-return-transport-data]. This is only the one-step identity and tower equations, without any assertion about longer iteration or point transport.

source.place: Last sentence, Frobenius transport: returned local normalization proof, Steps 2, 8, 9.

proof.text: Start with the integral scalar identity and tower clauses of the realization-coherence hypothesis. Apply the additive rationalization functor. Expand the rational scalar component, which is the rationalized integral component conjugated by the recorded pullback and scalar object-identification isomorphisms. The identity and tower comparisons are defined by the multiplication unit and normalized tensor associator. Their object-identification conjugations cancel in pairs. Functoriality of rationalization reduces the equations to the integral identity and tower clauses. This proves the two clauses at length one. At the zero object these are identity maps; for identity coefficients they give the multiplication unit, and for a repeated coefficient field they reduce to the same unit.
